\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{Number of factors of $m$ is 10}
\opt{B}{$m-n$ is odd number}
\opt{C}{$n$ is a factor of $m$}
\opt{D}{$n$ is a multiple of 6}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
